critical_code_review_comments: TopBar.jsx auto-hide: the scroll listener must be bound to whichever element actually accumulates scroll. On the current prod build, [data-testid='chat-messages'] is NOT a scroll container (scrollHeight === clientHeight === 808px). Verify which element handles scroll on a long chat — likely the parent .ds2-main wrapper or the messages list itself needs height:100% + min-height:0 + overflow-y:auto to become scrollable. Without this, the topbar can NEVER auto-hide regardless of how much content is added.

ChatPanel.jsx: the chat scroll container should add a data-testid='chat-scroll' explicitly on the actual overflow-y:auto element (separate from chat-messages) so the topbar hook can bind to it via getElementById/querySelector reliably. Today only chat-messages exists and it's the wrong (non-scrolling) element.
TopBar.jsx & ChatPanel.jsx: consider using ResizeObserver + scroll on the same ref so the hide transition fires consistently whether content overflows by 1px or 1000px.

rca_of_top_bug: TOPBAR AUTO-HIDE P0: REPRO — login → dashboard → in DevTools console: document.querySelector('[data-testid="chat-messages"]').scrollBy(0,800); → scrollTop stays at 0, topbar.getBoundingClientRect().height stays at 87px, no -translate-y-full applied. ROOT CAUSE — chat-messages element has scrollHeight === clientHeight === 808px (verified via Element.scrollHeight comparison). It is laid out as a flex child without overflow-y:auto / fixed-height, so content never overflows and the element never scrolls. The topbar's useScrollDirection-style hook (which subscribes to scroll events on this element OR on window) therefore never receives a scroll event of meaningful delta. FIX — set the messages list to flex:1 min-height:0 overflow-y:auto with a defined parent height, so adding new messages causes real overflow and real scroll events. Alternative — change the listener target to the correct overflowing ancestor. After the fix, retest with 10+ bubbles and confirm: scroll down 200px → topbar collapses to maxHeight:0 with -translate-y-full; scroll up → topbar springs back; mouse to top 20px while scrolled → topbar reappears.
